title: Glint-tolerant Sentinel-2 admission mask: moderate-glint radiometry
status_note: A concrete protocol prepared after reading r1. No r2 masks, corrected products or results have been computed. Implementation, input inventory and a verified content lock are required before execution; this file is not an execution record or an already-frozen input lock.
kind: Exploratory method assessment on previously inspected scenes. Pre-specifying the new analysis does not make these scenes an independent validation set.
question: Can a mask that separates clouds and land from moderate glint admit additional campaign-window Sentinel-2 water whose corrected radiometry passes predefined consistency checks?

scope.fixed_fieldwork: CCMAR dates are a constraint, set in advance by dive-centre availability. No rescheduling is assumed or recommended by this experiment.
excluded: Cover, presence, biomass, canopy-height or habitat-model fitting and threshold selection using field targets.
PNeo correction or resolution of the PNeo/Sentinel-2 land gain discrepancy.
An increase in ACOLITE's 0.05 pre-correction rhos SWIR application limit.
Re-estimating the 2017-2025 availability fractions under r2 without actually processing those scenes.
Claims of radiometric accuracy, signal preservation, bottom reflectance accuracy or kelp detection from internal consistency alone.
scope.preservation: Do not modify v1/r1 registrations, locks, outputs or reported results. Use out/r2/ and, if new processing is needed, .cache/acolite-r2/. Preserve failed scenes and all variants.

known_before_protocol: r1 reproduces v1 units and July scores under v1 rules. Consistent masking changes scores but leaves depth-only best on PNeo and the 14 surviving 2 July Sentinel-2 cells.

The review's july-shallow-T3-Q2 lookup used September predictions; that unit was scored in July. The PNeo reference NIR medians reported in the r1 review check are 0.023 in July and 0.011 in September; the approximately 0.03 values were unmasked means. Means, medians and masks must be identified explicitly.
r1's Sentinel-2 glint correction improves its registered diagnostics on 28 May, 2 July and 31 August. On 2 June R037, 9 July R037 and 5 July R080, its rhot SWIR mask leaves no water to assess.

The analysis mask uses rhot SWIR <= 0.0215. ACOLITE separately applies correction where pre-correction rhos near 1600 nm <= 0.05. These are different quantities and different decisions; the analysis mask does not control where ACOLITE has corrected the image.

The default SWIR correction can set its reference-band residual to zero by construction. Zero SWIR, lower brightness, unchanged land or a larger habitat/reference contrast ratio cannot independently validate that correction.
r1's NIR controls show no convincing visible-band information beyond the confounds. They do not prove that every visible-band pixel contains zero seabed signal.

r1 injection recovery is conditional on its models, endmembers, water, 2.5 m patch radius and position-error model. Failure to meet its 80% recovery criterion demonstrates poor power under those assumptions, not universal sensor incapacity.

Within a week of fixed June and July survey dates, 2/9 years in 2017-2025 had a scene likely to pass r1's screen; September had 7/9. These are screen-based estimates under those rules, not verified quadrat coverage or probabilities under a glint-tolerant method.

scenes.role: severe-glint stress case; may be outside the application limit

inputs_and_lock.scene_identity: Resolve each scene to the exact v1/r1 L1C product, granule, sensing time, processing baseline and existing output paths. Obtain the corresponding L2A SCL for that acquisition and tile, not a nearby date. Record its separate product identity and processor baseline.
inputs_and_lock.allowed_field_information: Geometry, event IDs, campaign, stratum and frozen eligibility only. Create a geometry-only inventory from the existing inventory without opening target files. Do not read cover or species columns in the r2 runner.
inputs_and_lock.geometry: Use the r1 habitat AOI, pneo_reference.geojson, lidar/DTM water support and registered quadrat geometry. Freeze their exact bytes. Do not redraw regions based on corrected images.
required_content_lock: This registration, the r2 runner and imported benchmark helpers, tests, and exact effective settings per variant.
Every consumed raster, SCL, product metadata file, geometry, geometry-only event inventory and water-level input, including reused V0/V1 output rasters.
ACOLITE source/configuration, sensor responses and LUT files actually used; imported coastal-library source and optical constants. Record SHA256 per file as well as Git revisions and dirty status.
Python version, dependency versions and a restorable snapshot of uncommitted source used in execution. A commit plus dirty=true is insufficient to reconstruct changed files.
inputs_and_lock.lock_order: Inventory metadata and implement with synthetic fixtures; then freeze sources and inputs before any r2 observational metrics. Verify the lock at each stage. Lock newly generated outputs in a child manifest before evaluation. Never silently update a failed lock.
inputs_and_lock.missing_inputs: Missing matching SCL, required TOA band, correction provenance or finite band support makes the affected scene not assessable, with a reason. No fallback that silently treats unknown pixels as clear.

grids_and_masks.assessment_grid: The native 20 m B11 grid of the acquisition. Average continuous 10 m reflectance into its 20 m footprint using fractional area. Keep native 20 m SCL categorical; use nearest-neighbour only for reprojection. A 60 m B10 failure excludes every intersecting 20 m cell. Report 10 m quadrat coverage separately; four upsampled subcells are not four independent SWIR measurements.
grids_and_masks.water_geometry: The finite lidar OR finite DTM water support used by r1, represented as a fixed geometry before reading r2 imagery. Retain cells with >= 80% water area and centre >= 20 m inside that geometry. This is a geometric proxy, not independently verified shoreline truth; record which source supplies support.

cloud_and_invalid.note: Geometric water, not SCL alone, determines water support. Classes 5 and 7 may retain misclassified glinted water but may also admit contamination. Report their area and results separately from class 6. Never reinterpret cloud classes as glint after seeing corrected outputs.
cloud_and_invalid.cirrus: Exclude rhot B10 > 0.005, following the pinned ACOLITE cirrus threshold, with the same 60 m buffer. Nonfinite B10 is unknown and excluded.
cloud_and_invalid.high_toa: Exclude any required science/control band (B2, B3, B4, B8A, B11 or B12) with rhot > 0.3, preserving the pinned ACOLITE high-TOA safeguard on these bands. Keep saturation/defect flags. Do not equate a failed high-TOA check with proven cloud.
cloud_and_invalid.finite_support: Require finite V0 rhos and rhot for B2, B3, B4, B8A, B11 and B12. Do not clip negative reflectance to zero.

grids_and_masks.M0: Reproduce r1's valid-water mask on its original grid, including rhot SWIR <= 0.0215, and report its original support. For the 20 m paired assessment, mark a 20 m cell M0 only when >= 80% of its area passes that original mask; report this aggregation separately. This is the historical comparator, not the new cloud definition.
grids_and_masks.M1_candidate: Geometric water AND cloud/invalid checks above AND pre-correction V0 rhos B11 <= 0.05. No rhot B11 <= 0.0215 condition and no corrected NIR, visible, QAA or target-dependent filter. The 0.05 bound intentionally matches ACOLITE's existing correction domain.

support_sets.lost: M0 AND NOT M1_candidate, separated by reason
support_sets.outside_domain: Passes geometric/cloud/finite checks but V0 rhos B11 > 0.05. Retain counts and maps; do not describe these cells as glint-corrected or rescued.

grids_and_masks.matched_comparisons: Fix each support set from V0 and auxiliary masks before evaluating corrections. Compare all variants on exactly those cells. A nonfinite corrected value is a failed cell, not permission to improve a score by dropping it. Report common and new support separately as well as their union.
grids_and_masks.diagnostic_sensitivity: Recompute support and summaries with shoreline distances 0 and 40 m, and with SCL class 6 only. All other rules stay fixed. These are sensitivity analyses; none can replace a failed primary result. No threshold sweep or choice of the best mask.

correction_variants.G0: V0 DSF without residual glint correction, frozen existing output where provenance permits.

G1_primary.note: Same science settings as r1 Sentinel-2 V1. Extra diagnostic outputs must not alter reflectance. If rerun, compare with r1 on common support and record any discrepancy before assessment.

correction_variants.G11_diagnostic: G1 with glint_force_band=1600: estimate correction from B11 only.
correction_variants.G12_diagnostic: G1 with glint_force_band=2200: estimate correction from B12 only.
correction_variants.use: G11/G12 test dependence on the correction reference; never choose the better-looking variant. Keep DSF aerosol settings, extent, ancillary settings and all other inputs identical. Verify raw rhot and the atmospheric solution remain unchanged across variants.
correction_variants.application_evidence: Save rhog reference and per-band correction, exact wavelength mapping, effective settings and an applied-pixel mask. Verify G0 rhos - G1 rhos agrees with saved rhog to float precision on attempted cells. Pixels skipped internally or lacking correction evidence cannot count as new corrected support. Do not apply correction twice.

assessment.threshold_status: The numerical cutoffs below are pre-specified engineering screens, not externally validated accuracy tolerances. The 0.002 change threshold comes from r1; 0.003 is a conservative working reflectance scale informed by E5s. Conclusions must remain conditional on these screens.
assessment.regions: Offshore reference polygon and habitat AOI, unchanged. Habitat common-mode measures use lidar depths 5-25 m. Report 5-10, 10-15 and 15-20 m separately, and quadrat shallow/deep support without reading cover.
assessment.minimum_support: For a scene-wide radiometric assessment require at least 100 distinct admitted 20 m reference cells and 50 habitat cells, each region spanning at least four fixed 100 m blocks. For the new support set require at least 25 cells spanning three blocks per region; otherwise its verdict is not_assessable even if pooled measures pass. Blocks are indexed by floor(easting/100), floor(northing/100).

checks.P1_application: All evaluated corrected cells have finite science/control bands and verified correction-domain membership. Any skipped/nonfinite fraction is reported; a support set with > 1% such cells fails, and metrics on remaining cells are descriptive only.
checks.P2_offshore_nir: On the same reference cells, median(abs(G1 B8A)) <= 0.01. If median(abs(G0 B8A)) >= 0.012, require a reduction >= 0.002; otherwise allow an increase of at most 0.002. Report signed medians, means and 5th/95th percentiles too. B8A is not used as the correction reference, but this remains a consistency check, not in-situ validation.
checks.P3_negative_visible: For each of B2 and B3, at most 5% of evaluated G1 cells in each region may be below -0.003. Report the full negative fractions for every band, including B4 and B8A. Never remove negative pixels before computing this check.
checks.P4_common_mode: Fit the r1 OLS depth slopes on the fixed habitat support. Define NIR amplitude = abs(slope_B8A) * 20 m. If G0 amplitude >= 0.002, require G1 amplitude <= 0.75 * G0 amplitude; otherwise require G1 amplitude <= 0.002. Show absolute blue, green and NIR slopes and depth ranges. Do not use NIR/green slope as a pass criterion: a changing or near-zero denominator can manufacture improvement.
checks.P5_reference_choice: On identical cells, for B2 and B3 separately, require median(abs(G11-G12)) <= 0.003 and its 90th percentile <= 0.006 in each region. Report B4/B8A and G1 comparisons too. Agreement does not exclude shared atmospheric or adjacency bias.
checks.P6_visual_contamination: Before corrected metrics are shown, inspect uncorrected RGB, NIR/SWIR and cloud-mask panels for a deterministic sample from new support. Within each region/SCL stratum (habitat then reference, classes 5, 6, 7), sort centres by SHA256 of the UTF-8 string scene_id|20m_row|20m_col with decimal indices. Cycle those six strata, taking the first remaining centre whose axis-aligned 60 m square does not overlap any selected square, until 30 patches are selected or candidates are exhausted. Assign clear-water, cloud/shadow, foam/whitecap, land/mixed or uncertain, without cover or corrected panels. Require >= 90% clear-water and no more than 5% confirmed contamination; uncertainty is not clear-water. Store reviewer, decisions and panels. These balanced sample fractions are an audit, not area-weighted contamination estimates or independent ground truth. If fewer than 10 patches are available, or review is incomplete, the verdict remains not_assessable. For common-support-only controls, apply the same audit to common support. It cannot edit the mask.

assessment.uncertainty: Report point metrics plus descriptive 95% intervals from 1000 spatial-block bootstrap draws (100 m blocks, seed 20261002), resampling whole blocks and pairing variants. Resampled/upsampled pixels are not independent replicates. Point thresholds determine the registered engineering verdict; intervals crossing thresholds mark it fragile, not statistically established.
assessment.qaa_separate_endpoint: Fit forced-560 QAA over the fixed admitted reference; automatic-reference QAA is diagnostic only. Use r1's informational/band-limited/fatal flag classes unchanged, including fatal pure-water-floor violations at <= 700 nm, and its >= 1000 original 10 m pixels requirement. Report native and 20 m counts, all flags, bbp(555), Kd near 490 and spectra. A fit passing these checks is plausible, not validated. Radiometry may improve while the optics branch remains unavailable; do not relax the red floor retrospectively.
non_decisive_diagnostics: Residual SWIR, correction magnitude and reference-band zeroing: implementation diagnostics, not independent proof of glint removal.
Land change: a software side-effect diagnostic. Unchanged excluded land cannot earn a pass.
Absolute habitat and reference MAD per band: report both. An increasing ratio caused by a shrinking reference MAD is not evidence of preserved seabed contrast.
Relationships of remaining visible residuals with NIR, glint correction, depth and distance to shore: describe possible confounds, not inferred kelp.

outcomes.per_scene: Each required check is pass, fail or not_assessable, with its support. Candidate radiometric recovery requires all P1-P6 to pass on the scene and the adequately supported new subset where applicable. Low-glint controls may use the P2/P4 non-degradation conditions. Never turn missing support into a pass.
outcomes.primary_endpoint: Count previously r1-unassessable June/July scenes with candidate radiometric recovery on new support, and report additional admitted quadrat cells by campaign and stratum. Retain a table of all six scenes. New offshore water without new quadrat support is not a recovered campaign matchup.
outcomes.control_requirement: A general claim that the method is promising also requires the 2 July and 31 August controls to pass their applicable checks. Report 28 May regardless. A failed/not-assessable control limits the conclusion; do not select only successful scenes.
outcomes.coverage: Report counts and area fractions at every step, and overlap of units across dates. Keep v1's 80% coverage rule visible as a historical comparator; a date below that threshold remains partial support. This experiment does not authorize a cover fit on a new subset.
outcomes.none_recovered: This mask within ACOLITE's default correction domain did not yield sufficiently supported consistent radiometry. It does not establish that all glint correction, stronger-glint processing or Sentinel-2 seabed sensing is impossible.
outcomes.some_recovered: Report additional campaign-window water passing specified radiometric checks, with uncertainty and partial coverage. This is an original processing/observability result, not detected kelp.
outcomes.next_gate: Before habitat inference, independently specify an adequately powered recovery/model test with the actual admitted support, depth interactions and patch-size/position sensitivities. Before radiometric validation or general availability claims, test unseen dates and obtain an independent radiometric reference where feasible. These follow-ons need separate registrations.

required_outputs: Input lock, source snapshot, effective settings and per-stage manifests with hashes.
Reason-coded candidate mask, historical M0, common/new/lost/outside-domain masks and verified correction-application rasters.
Per-scene attrition by region, SCL class, bathymetric depth and eligible quadrat stratum, preserving denominators.
Paired G0/G1/G11/G12 metric tables, failed checks, bootstrap intervals and complete QAA flag records.
Fixed-stretch before/after panels plus the pre-correction visual-audit decisions; no automatic contrast stretches presented as evidence.
A report separating admission, correction application, radiometric consistency, QAA plausibility and campaign coverage. State explicitly whether any kelp model was run (none in this registration).
implementation_checks_before_execution: An otherwise valid water pixel can pass M1 with rhot B11 > 0.0215, but not when V0 rhos B11 > 0.05. Distinguish rhot from rhos in units and tests.
Cloud, shadow, cirrus, saturation, missing-SCL and mixed-shore fixtures remain excluded despite low corrected SWIR or positive QAA results.
Changing corrected visible/NIR values or target files cannot change admission. Changing V0 reflectance may change the registered pre-correction checks.
Mask reprojection preserves categories; B10 exclusions and coarse support are not counted as independent 10 m observations.
Comparisons keep identical support, retain negative values, and mark skipped correction/nonfinite outputs as failures.
No pass can be earned from zero reference SWIR, unchanged land or a vanishing contrast denominator.
A changed dependency file fails content-lock verification, including an uncommitted QAA change.

references.role: Known results and limitations motivating this protocol.
r1 masks, variants, radiometry and flag definitions.
Pinned default SWIR glint implementation; application cutoff, band choice, correction diagnostics.
Separate l2w, cirrus, high-TOA and glint-application settings.
SCL class meanings and categorical cloud information. Use the actual product baseline in the input lock; SCL is not independent truth.
